title: Remediate Dependabot alerts for mako and ujson

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting remediation for open Dependabot alerts #114 (Mako) and #123 (ujson): branch from develop, update lockfile to fixed versions, validate with OSV/Snyk, then commit/push and open PR.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Updated poetry.lock to resolve mako 1.3.12 and ujson 5.12.1 (fixed versions for GHSA-2h4p-vjrc-8xpq and GHSA-c38f-wx89-p2xg). Validation: snyk test on poetry.lock shows no mako/ujson findings; poetry check passes; osv-scanner no longer reports mako/ujson vulnerabilities.
